feature.title: Modular Walls
feature.description: Add a new runtime-generated modular wall system independent of the Satellit GLB model. Curators can create, position, rotate, and lock free-standing partition walls inside the exhibition room. Walls are parametric (BoxGeometry), support artwork placement on their surfaces, and their state is persisted per ExhibitionVersion so each version captures a unique wall layout. Walls are intended to be arranged during the initial exhibition setup phase and can be locked to prevent accidental movement during artwork placement.

inScope.item: Runtime-generated modular walls as BoxGeometry meshes (not from GLB)
Wall creation via toolbar button (adds a wall at a default position in the scene)
Wall positioning and rotation via existing TransformControls (translate + rotate)
Wall lock/unlock toggle per wall (locked walls cannot be moved)
Configurable wall dimensions: width, height, thickness
Wall material/color selection (white default, optional color picker)
Artwork raycasting on modular wall surfaces (same placement flow as room walls)
Artworks parented to modular walls (move with the wall when unlocked and repositioned)
Wall state persistence as part of ExhibitionVersion snapshots
Wall deletion with confirmation (removes wall and detaches/deletes placed artworks)
Physics colliders for modular walls (first-person collision in viewer mode)
Visual distinction: subtle outline or label to differentiate modular walls from room walls

outOfScope.item: Modification of the Satellit GLB model or its React component
Snap-together wall modules or L/T-junction prefabs (future enhancement)
Wall-to-wall collision detection (walls may overlap; curator is responsible)
Constraint zone enforcement for walls (Phase 8 — can be integrated later)
Custom wall textures or materials beyond solid colors

dataModel.relationship: ArtworkInstance may optionally reference a ModularWall via a nullable wallId field. When wallId is set, the artwork's position is stored relative to the wall's local coordinate system. Moving the wall recalculates artwork world positions on the frontend.

implementationNotes.note: The Satellit GLB and its React component (Satellit.tsx) must NOT be modified
Modular walls are added to the Scene alongside the Satellit component, not inside it
Wall Y position defaults to height/2 so the wall sits on the floor (origin is center of BoxGeometry)
Default wall dimensions: 2.0m wide × 2.5m tall × 0.12m thick (realistic partition wall)
Rotation should be constrained to Y-axis only for simplicity (walls don't tilt)
Locked walls should have a distinct visual indicator (e.g., slightly different border or subtle lock icon)
Consider limiting the maximum number of modular walls per version (e.g., 20) for performance

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Curator can add a new modular wall to the scene via a toolbar button
Modular wall appears as a white rectangular partition at floor level
Curator can select, move (translate), and rotate the wall using TransformControls
Curator can adjust wall dimensions (width, height, thickness) in the PropertiesPanel
Curator can lock a wall to prevent movement; locked walls show a visual lock indicator
Curator can drag an image from the AssetSidebar and drop it onto a modular wall surface
Artwork placed on a modular wall moves with the wall when the wall is repositioned
Wall state (positions, dimensions, lock status) is saved as part of version snapshots
Loading a different version restores modular walls to their saved positions
Deleting a wall detaches any artworks placed on it (artworks are not deleted, but lose their wall parent)
In first-person viewer mode, the player collides with modular walls
Modular walls do not require any changes to the Satellit GLB or its component
